ext_description.message: Shows the LinkedIn profile of the sender in Gmail / Outlook web. Open source, your own provider keys, data stays in your browser.

header_name_vs_profile.message: Name in the email: $1 · name on the profile: $2

skip_free_mail.message: Personal mailbox domain, skipped by default

skip_role.message: Shared / role address, skipped by default

err_no_keys.message: No provider key yet. One is enough: treg (cheapest) or Monid (best coverage). Open the extension settings.

err_auto_limit.message: Automatic lookups reached today's limit of $1. Click to look up manually.

popup_no_keys.message: No provider key yet. One is enough: treg (cheapest) or Monid (best coverage). Open settings.

opt_auto_lookup.message: Look up the sender automatically when a message opens

popup_hint.message: Keys, cache and history stay in this browser.

tagline.message: Open source · your own keys · data stays on this device

keys_intro.message: One key is enough. treg is the cheapest (email only, roughly half of work addresses); Monid has the best coverage (Apollo matches on name + company domain, dearer); Firecrawl is an optional last fallback. Keys stay in this browser and are sent only to their own provider.

steps_intro.message: Tried top to bottom, stops at the first hit. The price is the catalog price cap accepted for that step.

step_signature.message: LinkedIn link in the email signature

relookup_title.message: Ignore the cache and look up again (may cost money)

chart_aria.message: Daily lookups and spend, last 30 days

data_intro.message: Cache, history and the spend ledger live in this browser's IndexedDB. Export before switching computers or clearing browser data. On import, newer records win. Exports never contain keys.

import_confirm_replace.message: This clears the cache, history and ledger on this device, then imports the file. Continue?

import_bad_json.message: The file is not valid JSON

clear_confirm.message: Clear all cache, history and ledger? This cannot be undone; previously looked-up addresses will cost money again.

about_text.message: Open source (AGPL-3.0). There is no server: lookups go from your browser straight to the providers you entered keys for, and results are stored only on this device.

about_gdpr.message: You are the controller of the lookups you run: only the email address, display name and company domain are sent, results stay on this device (90 days by default) and can be deleted on the History and Data tabs.

tele_intro.message: On by default; switch it off here if you prefer. When on, once a day the extension posts one summary of the previous day: how many lookups ran and how they ended, which steps were called and how often they hit, which mail client they came from, and the rounded total spend. Never any email address, name, domain, LinkedIn URL, profile field, key or message content. Switching it off deletes the installation id and anything unsent.

tele_off_toast.message: Off. Installation id and unsent data deleted

connect_title_attr.message: Open this person's LinkedIn profile. When you click Connect and Add a note there, the invitation note is filled in for you; you press Send.

local_time_title.message: Time zone guessed from the profile location: $1

connect_note_default.message: Hi {first}, we were just in touch by email and I'd like to stay connected here too.

li_filled.message: The note is filled in. Review it and press Send yourself; the extension never sends.

li_pending.message: An invitation to this person is already pending.

li_login.message: Please sign in to LinkedIn, then click Connect on the email card again.

li_note_limit.message: LinkedIn says your personalised invitations for this month are used up. You can still send without a note.

connect_intro.message: To fill in the invitation note, the extension needs access to linkedin.com pages that it opens itself. You grant this once.

connect_step1.message: The person's LinkedIn profile opens in a new tab.

connect_step2.message: You click "Connect" and "Add a note" on LinkedIn. The extension fills in the note below the moment the note box appears.

connect_step3.message: You read it and press "Send" yourself. The extension never clicks Connect or Send on its own and never runs on LinkedIn pages you open yourself.

connect_limit_hint.message: LinkedIn limits notes to 300 characters, and free accounts get only a few invitations with a note per month. You can edit the template in the extension settings.

connect_nothing_pending.message: Nothing pending. Go back to the email and click Connect again.

connect_denied.message: Permission not granted, so the note cannot be filled in for you. You can still copy it from the preview above and paste it on LinkedIn.

opt_connect_intro.message: The "Connect" button in the panel opens the person's profile; when you click Connect and Add a note on LinkedIn, the invitation note below is filled in for you and you press Send. Placeholders: {first} first name, {name} full name, {company} company.

opt_connect_note_placeholder.message: Leave empty for the default template

opt_connect_signature.message: Append the "sent via SenderFinder" line to the note

opt_connect_perm_none.message: linkedin.com not yet granted (asked the first time you click Connect)

panel_empty_hint.message: Open a message in Gmail or Outlook on the web. The sender's LinkedIn profile appears here.

chip_title.message: Show the LinkedIn profile in the side panel

chip_open_fallback.message: Click the extension icon in the toolbar to open the side panel

hint_noisy.message: Notification-style address, not looked up automatically

li_copy_debug.message: Copy details for a bug report

li_instructions.message: Click "Connect", then "Add a note": the invitation note will be filled in for you. Or copy it and paste it yourself.

li_add_note.message: The invitation dialog is open. Click "Add a note" and the note will be filled in.

li_grant.message: Show photos and your LinkedIn relationship

li_grant_title.message: Reads each profile once with your own LinkedIn login in this browser. Nothing is posted.

li_signed_out.message: Sign in to LinkedIn in this browser to see the relationship

panel_slogan.message: Find the email sender on LinkedIn

li_link_broken.message: This LinkedIn link does not open: the data provider gave a wrong address.

li_relookup_hint.message: Asks the providers again (a paid lookup)

keys_need_one.message: Nothing is configured yet. Add at least one key: treg (cheapest) or Monid (best coverage). Firecrawl alone is not recommended.

vendor_treg_tagline.message: Cheapest. Email-only reverse lookups, from $$0.0005 per hit.

vendor_monid_tagline.message: Best coverage. Hunter by email, Apollo by email + name + company domain (about $$0.03).

vendor_firecrawl_tagline.message: Optional last fallback (Data Legion). Billed in credits.
